ALIAS.chain.description: An alias computed from another alias: expression form, function form, gathers of aliases

ALIAS.change_propagation.name: Alias change propagation
ALIAS.change_propagation.description: A change (parameter, table values, gathered table) recomputes exactly the dependent aliases

DASHBOARD.histogram_only.name: Example dashboard: histograms only (testBokehClientHistogramOnlyHisto)
DASHBOARD.histogram_only.description: An oracle test dashboard: RootInteractive's own example dashboard, built by its original function on a reproducible table, in Chromium: the A range slider moved with the keyboard, the Cumulative tab opened and closed, everything restored; selected rows, all histoA bins, cumulative and CDF, and the drawn plots (x and y values, labels, painted positions, visible or hidden) equal numpy at every step; live faults in the page are caught

DASHBOARD.weights_reference.name: Example dashboard: analysis weights against reference weights (test_interactiveTemplateWeightsRef)
DASHBOARD.weights_reference.description: An oracle test dashboard: RootInteractive's WeightsRef template dashboard, built by its original function on a reproducible table, in Chromium with real input (tab click, weight and transform selects, bin spinner, A slider keys, restore): the selected rows, both sides' weighted 2-D counts, the analysis and reference profiles (entries, mean, std, quantiles), all drawn series, the comparison curves and the error bars of the means equal numpy at every step, by the Architect's decisions; known defects WT-D6, WR-D1, WT-D14; live faults are caught

DISPLAY.axis_label.name: Parametric axis label (ConcatenatedString)
DISPLAY.axis_label.description: Axis title from a template with a parameter, option metadata (AxisTitle) and None; follows the widget, in Node and in Chromium

DISPLAY.downsampler.name: Downsampled scatter (DownsamplerCDS)
DISPLAY.downsampler.description: At most nPointRender of the selected rows, in source order, deterministic per table, following filter and nPointRender changes; selections map back to the source rows

DISPLAY.graph3d.name: 3D graph (BokehVisJSGraph3D, vis.js)
DISPLAY.graph3d.description: The 3D graph takes x, y, z and style from the right columns and rows of a public-builder page (also reordered and under a widget filter); in Chromium the view hands exactly those points to vis.js, a real mouse drag turns the view, and a data change reaches vis.js and redraws

DISPLAY.lazy_tabs.name: Lazy tabs (LazyTabs)
DISPLAY.lazy_tabs.description: Plots in a hidden tab are not recomputed until the tab opens, then show the current selection; real tab click in Chromium

DSL.math_functions.name: Math functions

DSL.server_client_parity.name: One expression, one result
DSL.server_client_parity.description: An expression computed in the browser (alias) and on the server (shown directly) gives the same column

ENC.cds_compress.data_replace.name: Compressed table: replacing its data in a live page
ENC.cds_compress.data_replace.description: After inputData is replaced, every column and the histogram show the new data (known defect TR-D1: columns decoded before the replacement keep their old values)

ENC.cds_compress.length_guard.name: Compressed table: a column of the wrong length is refused
ENC.cds_compress.length_guard.description: Reading a column whose decoded length differs from the table's raises 'Corrupted length of column ...' (known defect TR-D2: refused only on the first read, returned on the second)

ENC.cds_compress.page_decode.name: Compressed table in a page (CDSCompress): lossless decoding
ENC.cds_compress.page_decode.description: A page built with lossless compression (zip, base64) decodes every column exactly (NaN, +-inf, -0 kept), only when the column is read, and reuses the decoded array; a weighted histogram on the compressed table follows a range filter, an empty range and the full range again

FILTER.text_query.description: Rows selected by a typed JavaScript condition over the table's columns, toggleable, with real typing in Chromium
